name: dimakrest-context-engineering
description: Context Engineering plugin - complete development workflow with specialized agents, commands, and skills

plugins.name: context-engineering
plugins.description: Complete development workflow with specialized agents, commands, skills, and execution context. Provides 10 agents for code research and implementation, 6 commands for structured development workflows, 5 skills (commit, debug, describe-pr, code-review-by-team, setup-statusline).

plugins.name: missions
plugins.description: Contract-first multi-feature agent missions: plan the definition of done, run serial workers with blind review and behaviour validation, enforced by hooks (writer lock, execution lease, spend/dispatch caps, blindness, commit discipline).

plugins.name: flows
plugins.description: Run a flow of inner pull requests through Orca workers: a router handles the mailbox and each PR's chain of steps and checks, and rings the coordinator only at a gate, a failure or a worker's question.
